title: Desk Card — Price-Protection Limit by Marlowe Rewards Tier (Pre-Orders & Back-Orders)
content:
**Rule.** Under Pre-Orders & Back-Orders price protection, the protection limit is the share of the reserved unit price by which the reserved price may be lowered. It depends on the customer's Marlowe Rewards tier:

| Marlowe Rewards membership | Protection limit |
|---|---|
| Active Icon or Atelier member | 15 percent of the reserved unit price |
| Active Gold or Platinum member | 10 percent of the reserved unit price |

For every other customer, including Member and Silver members and anyone whose membership is not active, the membership tier does not change the protection limit.

**Record read.** The tier and status of the customer's Marlowe Rewards membership. No enrolment period applies to this limit: the tier held is enough.

**Quick checks (hypothetical reservations at $300.00)**

| Membership | Limit | Most the price can come down |
|---|---|---|
| Active Atelier | 15 percent | $45.00, to $255.00 |
| Active Platinum | 10 percent | $30.00, to $270.00 |
| Active Gold, enrolled 2 months | 10 percent | $30.00, to $270.00 |
| Suspended Icon | Not changed by tier | — |
